title: Playing with Rene and Clayton; bands then and now
summary: He never played with Buddy Petit but sometimes with Rene, playing harmony under his high notes. He says Clayton plays higher and louder now than before, and that bands today sound like those of the 1920s-30s.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Let's see, we were talking about the Chris Kelly band. Did you play with any other bands like that? Did you ever play with Buddy Petit? No, I never did play with Buddy Petit. Well, let's say he used to play a lot of high notes on his trumpet. He did. Well, how was that for the coronet to play along with him? It didn't worry me at that time. Then when he would play, he didn't blast his horn. But now it looks like he was up late, he blasts it, you know? He seems to play a lot of high stuff. Yeah, high stuff.
